images.prompt: Camera and composition: hero shot of the one key object of the topic, large in the frame and slightly from above, on a simple surface, no people. Keep the top fifth of the image as softly blurred or plain background (a title band goes there). A bundle of new house keys resting on top of an entryway shoe cabinet in a newly moved-in apartment, a few moving boxes softly blurred. Color theme: apricot and ivory tones with a sage green accent. Soft matte clay 3D render, rounded chunky shapes, handmade plasticine texture, gentle studio lighting, miniature diorama feel, richer and more saturated colors than pastel, clear contrast, cozy and warm mood. Base colors cream, apricot, mint, sky blue and warm brown, a little deeper than pastel. Add one bright accent color (coral-red, mustard yellow or cobalt blue) on the main person's clothing or the key object. Korean people and Korean everyday settings. Show only what the image's own scene describes; do not repeat the post's main object in every image. Topic-specific details (medical, tools, places) are welcome where the scene calls for them. Everyone looks calm and relaxed — smiling, or thoughtful and curious; nobody is in pain, sad or scared. Do not draw any written words, letters or numbers anywhere in the image; signs, posters, screens and papers stay blank or use simple icons only. No money, banknotes, coins or currency symbols anywhere.
